prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right one depends on what you need (brand strategy vs. lead generation vs. physician recruitment vs. PR), your budget, timeline, and the type of organization (hospital system, specialty clinic, health tech/startup, etc.).

Quick questions so I can recommend the best matches:
- What type of organization are you (hospital, health system, clinic, medical device/health tech, insurer, etc.)?
- Which services do you need most (branding, paid digital advertising, SEO/content, social, PR/crisis comms, physician recruitment, analytics/CRM, creative/video)?
- Approximate annual marketing budget or monthly retainer range?
- Do you prefer a local agency only (St. Louis) or are national firms acceptable?
- Any must-haves (HIPAA experience, EHR integration, multilingual, B2B vs B2C)?

If you want, I can:
- Send a short list (3–5) of St. Louis agencies that specialize in healthcare with pros/cons and example work,
- Or give a decision checklist and RFP template you can use to vet agencies.

Which would you prefer?
